COD.rationale: Content (red coordinates), an explicit origin/representation entry and the separate content line coexist for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition is linked to the identified content's presentation/access; presence of command/branch codes alone does not qualify.

C.rationale: Multiple lines explicitly identify content items (color-tagged coordinate sets) with attributes.

D.rationale: The report separately records the identified content and a distinct origin/representation status for the same referent/time.

O.rationale: Origins and 'current' vs 'candidate' entries describe how contents are represented/accessed; candidate entries indicate prospective representation.
